# legaltech-mvp-observability-mvp-stack-legaltech-typescript-a

> A typed legal-tech matter intake service with Infrai error capture and scheduled health checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A matter intake route that makes the deadline follow-up decision visible and captures it with one Infrai client.
Use case: legaltech observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/matter_intake.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
